scope.delivery: Unpublished additive source after 0.0.10; no installed application or device acceptance.
scope.atomicSemantics: SET-only nonempty string subset bound to one existing canonical instanceId. Original complete scene parsed before editing; final complete scene parsed after all requested net changes. Existing author name uses 1–256 Unicode codepoints, including whitespace/control/CRLF/astral text, with no trimming or normalization; colors inherit hex6.
scope.noOp: Native and bridge accept exact original bytes with []; independent private-branded authoring proposal rejects unchanged approval.
scope.limits: Each whole original/final scene limited to 128 KiB UTF-8; existing full scene3d schema and all model/cross-field constraints inherited.
scope.tokenPreservation: Only selected net string value CST spans replaced with canonical JSON strings. Unchanged decoded strings preserve escapes. All keys, numeric/exponent/signed-zero lexemes, geometry, IDs, other objects, scene/environment, BOM/CRLF and outside bytes retained.

freshWasmBuild.buildOwner: Root performed the centralized fresh native/WASM build.

regressions: Immutable name/color key tokens reject semantic-equivalent key-swap forged receipts.
All non-string source intervals remain exact, rejecting unrelated numeric/geometry edits and exponent/signed-zero/trivia rewrites.
Existing domain probes stay independent; missing/version2 properties probe leaves available old parse/transform/objects/environment operations usable.
Raw decoded duplicate keys, including null-first values, reject before Value can erase request intent.
boundaries: New operation/probe is additive; old parse, transforms, objects, environment, 2D, author schema and backend contracts unchanged.
Bridge needs old parse and own version1 probe only; no dependency on other edit domains.
Native parser owns semantic constraints; bridge only strict JSON DTO, expected full model, exact lexical inventory and response defense.
No JS semantic rule replica, YAML, Node, DOM, property parser, filesystem, Save, renderer, World command or backend execution in bridge.
Original scene parse codes unchanged; invalid values/final model uses scene3d_properties_invalid, source/candidate budget scene3d_limit, malformed request studio_core_request_invalid.
Ordinary domain failures retain runtime availability; forged successful receipts poison runtime.
Shared regression includes new bridge tests; counts from separate runs are not added.
